summary: This bill expresses the sense of Congress that votes from uniformed servicemembers and overseas citizens must be counted and honored as required by the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (UOCAVA), and calls on the Attorney General to monitor and enforce compliance with UOCAVA.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on ensuring that the votes of overseas servicemembers and citizens are counted and honored as required by the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (UOCAVA). It aims to expand voting access for these specific groups by reaffirming federal protections and calling for enforcement of existing law.
